scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web,probe -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w web" "npm:dev -w probe"
scripts.build: npm run build -w probe && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit && tsc -p probe --noEmit
